objective: Frozen computation: caps d = 3 and 4, linear and quadratic prices, and the rules told no number, from lines of 5 to 12 and from Q3 and the 3 x 3 x 3 grid, runs to n = 60.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (referee pending; 9 of 9 held): caps of 3 and 4 give exactly 3 and 4 orders with full grids; linear prices give one order (w > 2) or 4-5 by n = 40 (w < 2), quadratic ones settle at 4, 3, 2, 1; of six rules told no number, the seed-and-copy rule and the odd-cycle rule (the cap in parity's words) keep two orders and recur through full two-way grids from every line of 5 to 12, the fresh-crossing rule keeps two in separate blocks, the rest do not; every rule keeps three from three-way starts.
